key_insight: CrystalAR unifies symmetry-template and crystal-structure generation in one autoregressive sequence, expressing continuous atomic positions through hierarchical discrete localization.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a symmetry-preserving route to new crystal candidates and crystal structure prediction without retrieving symmetry templates from prior data.
method: Jointly generate Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures.
Refine symmetry-inequivalent site positions across discrete spatial resolution levels, jointly modeling sites within each level.
Use constraint-aware search over crystallographic templates and geometric realizations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong symmetry-template generation and competitive de novo generation and template-free crystal structure prediction, but provides no benchmark names or quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical use should assess how spatial resolution and constraint-aware search affect geometric accuracy and computational cost.
paper_title: CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
